final_heard: Education does not need another answer box. Canopy turns nine subjects into visible interactive reasoning journeys. The sixth stage constellation moves from observation to modeling and validation. The final stage transfers knowledge while one teacher preserves the learner's context, switch to Romanian or Arabic. Twenty languages translate the full learning surface and right to left layout keep scientific models correctly oriented. The learner explains, Canopy reveals evidence, confidence, a misconception, hypothesis, mastery, and the next question instead of hiding behind a score. Its optional multilingual model can run inside the browser using web GPU or web assembly. The inspectable local rubric remains available without an account or API key. Teachers paste their material into course forge. Canopy extracts six editable stages locally and requires teacher review before anything is saved. The evidence view reports only observed interactions, explanation quality, recovery time, and a course heat map. Never invented pilot results. The device local learner model keeps mastery, misconceptions, spaced review, unportable, exports. Voice screen reader announcements, contrast dyslexia friendly type, and reduced motion-wide access. Canopy ends with transfer. One accountable AI teacher across school science and the humanities, ready now in an ordinary browser.
